objectives.title: List your workspace channels
objectives.why: Discovering channels grounds the agent before it posts anywhere.

objectives.title: Post your first message
objectives.why: Posting is the core action — get a message into a channel.

objectives.title: Reply in a thread
objectives.why: Threading keeps channels readable instead of a wall of top-level noise.

objectives.title: React to a message
objectives.why: Reactions are a lightweight way for a bot to acknowledge without adding noise.

objectives.title: Read channel history
objectives.why: Reading context before acting is what separates a helpful bot from a spammy one.

bestPractices.title: Keep your Slack bot token out of git
bestPractices.why: A leaked bot token lets anyone post as your app.

bestPractices.title: Post considerately: threads over spam, respect rate limits
bestPractices.why: A bot that floods channels or ignores rate limits gets muted or removed.

criteria.rubric: Does the Slack integration prefer thread replies and reactions over channel spam, and handle rate limiting (429 / Retry-After) gracefully?

badges.name: Key Keeper
badges.description: Kept your bot token out of git.

badges.name: Good Citizen
badges.description: Posts considerately and respects rate limits.
